items.title: Tom Albert Interview, 1962-05-07
items.q: I believe I did have Skeeter. I believe Skeeter did play with me then.

ctx.x: Was it before Skeeter played with you? I'm the guitar player?
I believe I did have Skeeter. I believe Skeeter did play with me then. I think he did. Yeah, he played a while with me too. What was Skeeter's name?
No, I don't know his other name.
